canonical_claim: Before an F1 propagation fix, a read-only `Store::open` still called `PoolMeta::createOrValidate` unconditionally (`CasStore.cpp:122,134`), which does `casPut(..., expected=nullopt)` (create-if-missing, `CasPoolMeta.cpp:129`); over an EMPTY/wrong prefix this either mutates storage or throws a write-permission error instead of cleanly reporting "pool absent" — only the capability probe was skipped for `read_only`, not the meta write. Only bites read-only-over-empty; over a live pool with existing `_pool_meta` the call only validates.; `Store::open` should expose explicit create, read-write existing, and read-only existing modes so read-only opening cannot silently create `_pool_meta` or roots.
current_evidence: not_found: CasStore.cpp:122,134, casPut(..., expected=nullopt), CasPoolMeta.cpp:129 — none of the cited call sites/lines exist; current code is Pool::open/PoolMeta::createOrValidate (CasPool.cpp:494, CasPoolMeta.cpp:108) which passes an allow_mint parameter (PoolConfig, CasPool.h:164), contradicting the claim's specific unconditional-create mechanism.
